meta.title: Scenario: MLflow experiments, models, and Apps

views.label: Export before cutover
views.note: mlflow-export-import copies runs, metric history, and artifacts -- it does not move UC data.

views.label: Model registry re-point
views.note: Registered models move to UC-based registry; serving endpoints re-point to the new model URIs.

views.label: Apps redeploy, they don't migrate
views.note: A Databricks App is redeployed against target, not copied -- its source repo is the unit that moves.

cards.title: Export is not a data-plane copy
items: mlflow-export-import walks experiments via SearchRunsIterator and pulls full get_metric_history() per run -- no truncated metrics
Artifacts move alongside runs; large artifact stores still dominate export time
Run this before the UC catalog cutover, against source while it's still live

cards.title: Registered models re-target UC
items: Workspace Model Registry entries become UC-registered models under the target catalog/schema
Serving endpoints are redefined against the new model URI, not just repointed by name
A model version missing from export is a registry gap found at serving time, not export time -- reconcile catches it first

cards.title: Apps redeploy, they don't migrate
items: A Databricks App's compute and secrets are workspace-local -- only its source (repo/bundle) is portable
Redeploy against target from the same CI/CD pipeline used for the source app, not a manual copy
Verify app-to-model and app-to-table references resolve against target before cutover
